text.zh: 第一方 Skill、模板和维护文档采用项目明确约定的主要语言；约定缺失时先对齐维护者需求。协议字段、命令、文件名和代码标识符遵循工具契约。第三方上游材料保持原文；本地派生版记录来源和维护边界，翻译不改变运行契约。
text.en: First-party Skills, templates and maintenance docs use the main language the project explicitly agreed on; when no convention exists, align with the maintainer first. Protocol fields, commands, file names and code identifiers follow the tool contract. Keep third-party upstream material in its original language; record the source and maintenance boundary of a local derivative, and a translation must not change the runtime contract.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 编写、维护或翻译第一方 Skill、模板与维护文档时
trigger.en: When writing, maintaining or translating first-party Skills, templates and maintenance docs

purpose.zh: 按项目约定的语言统一维护，并保证翻译不改变运行契约
purpose.en: Maintain consistently in the project's agreed language and make sure translation does not change the runtime contract

exclude.zh: 协议字段、命令、文件名和代码标识符（遵循工具契约）；第三方上游材料
exclude.en: Protocol fields, commands, file names and code identifiers (they follow the tool contract); third-party upstream material
